TL;DR – Confident AI is a cloud-based evaluation platform to help teams build reliable AI products.
Its evals are powered by DeepEval - an open-source LLM evaluation framework, which has over 12k stars, 3million monthly downloads, runs 2million evals per day, and is most commonly found in CI/CD pipelines of enterprises such as BCG, Astrazeneca, AXA, Microsoft.
Confident AI allows engineering teams to iterate on their LLM app x10 faster by bringing best-in-class evals to traditional AI observability.
Try Confident AI today (setup in 5 min)

The Solution
We built DeepEval for engineers to create use-case-specific, deterministic LLM evaluation metrics, and when you're ready, Confident AI brings these evaluation results to the cloud for collaboration. This allows teams to collaborate on LLM app iteration — with no extra setup required.
